name: [NEW] Bubble Blasters
desc:
Grab your blaster and get ready to shoot some bubbles! In Bubble Blasters, your aim is everything — pop floating bubbles mid-air to earn cash, unlock awesome crates, and discover a collection of unique and flashy blaster skins! 💸🔫

🎯 AIM. SHOOT. POP!
Aim and blast as many bubbles as you can before they disappear. Each pop earns you money!

💸 STACK YOUR CASH!
Use your hard-earned money to open crates packed with exclusive gun skins and surprise rewards.

✨ UNLOCK AND FLEX!
Collect rare skins, upgrade your blasters, and show off your style as the ultimate bubble-popping champ!

Can you pop your way to the top and unlock the rarest skin of all?

Made with passion by YGDS ❤️
